plain_english: Look at the powerful people around you — the ones everyone admires. Even they are slaves. They are slaves to ambition, to other people's opinions, to their own fear of losing what they have.
original_excerpt: Even the pleasures of such men are uneasy and disquieted by alarms of various sorts.
source_reference: On the Shortness of Life, Section 8 (attributed)

plain_english: The only people who truly have time are those who spend it on wisdom. They are the only ones who are really alive. The rest are just busy.
original_excerpt: Of all men they alone are at leisure who take time for philosophy, they alone really live.
source_reference: On the Shortness of Life, Section 14

plain_english: You act as if you have an unlimited supply of time. You do not. Every day that passes belongs to death. The only day you own is today — and even that is not guaranteed.
original_excerpt: You live as if you were destined to live forever, no thought of your frailty ever enters your head.
source_reference: On the Shortness of Life, Section 9 (attributed)
